title: 401s for some adjusters after the IdP rotated its signing key
scenario: Since Tuesday morning about 40% of adjusters get 'session expired' from the ClaimDesk API. Nothing was deployed, retries sometimes work, and on-call suspects an 18-second clock drift on one node. The logs from four gateway nodes, the gateway startup and the Okta system log hold the answer.
task: Correlate failures by node, user and kid; explain why retries sometimes work
Rule the NTP drift theory in or out
Fix JwksCache: maxAge refresh, rate-limited refresh on unknown kid, survive IdP outages
Write the root cause with log evidence and the immediate mitigation
acceptance: Rotated keys verify on long-running nodes; previous keys still verify
Unknown-kid floods and concurrent misses cause at most one fetch per interval
Retired keys drop after maxAge; outages keep cached keys
ANSWER.md names the startup-only JWKS load with evidence
